user_request: 那就换一下；承接从零开始的短程三组匹配对照建议
budget_choice: Assistant selected1B tokens per run for the requested short comparison; no automatic10B extension
data_note: Existing fixed1B cache is the byte-identical first1B prefix of the previous10B cache; identical dev/test. No download or tokenization duplication in staging.

orthogonal_parameterization.generator: 3 input-dependent coordinates from RMS-normalized flattened4D state
orthogonal_parameterization.map: Q=e e.T + C Cayley(A) C.T, where e=(1,1,1,1)/2, C=three Hadamard contrast columns, A=3x3 skew matrix
orthogonal_parameterization.backend: NVIDIA TE projection/scale/expand-combine and their backward; new small coefficient map uses compiledFP32 PyTorch
orthogonal_parameterization.family: signed common-preserving SO(3); no final Sinkhorn, no SVD, no orthogonal penalty
limitations: The dynamic whole-module Jacobian need not be orthogonal.
BF16 output rounding is not exactly norm-preserving.
SO(3) Cayley chart excludes exact180-degree rotations at finite coordinates.
Per-stream RMSNorm and head softcap are unchanged and not isometries.

optimizer: Default native MuonAdamW; mixers use existing connector AdamW group, unembedding LR/no weight decay; head is unchanged AdamW
initialization: All shared backbone, connector and head parameters bitwise matched, same token order and fixed vocabulary partition
comparison_limits: Single seed and only1B; not a general effectiveness claim.
Different mixer parameter counts and initial coefficient spectra are reported.
Earlier stopped runs used a10B learning-rate schedule; do not use their partial losses as matched1B controls.
backbone_mhc: All16 attention/MLP connectors retain original20-step Sinkhorn

gate.restart: Each mode25 steps -> exit85 -> fresh process50
